title: LIVE SOLAR RADIATION
source_name: NOAA/NCEP RAP (Rapid Refresh) hourly surface DSWRF (downward short-wave radiation flux)
variable: DSWRF surface, newest RAP cycle valid for the current hour (analysis step when present, else shortest forecast lead)
temporal: hourly RAP cycle; value valid for the current hour (lead time recorded per run)
what: Modeled incoming sunlight energy at the surface (broadband: includes ultraviolet, visible, and near-infrared solar energy). This is not a UV Index and not a visible-light meter reading. An hourly weather-model estimate, not a ground sensor measurement at every location. Nighttime reads zero (valid data, near-black) — not missing data. Clouds reduce values quantitatively versus clear sky.
why_extreme: Rare peak midday clear-sky values approach near-white; ordinary day/night conditions own most of the color resolution.
